notes: Fixes the morning burst of bogus activity: chores still marked complete from the day before were being re-logged as 'finished' (and re-earning points) at the first tick of each new day. The board now only records a completion it actually watched happen. Chores nobody did still show as 'missed' at the nightly reset - the feed tells the truth now. (Includes v1.56.0: auto-reset chores wear an amber reset arrow on the chore board instead of a green checkmark.)
